records.contract: compute(type: u8, data: *const u8, n: usize, last_byte: u8) -> u32
records.semantics: dispatches on type; type 2 (kxxHash) returns XXH32(data || last_byte, seed 0); any other type returns 0 except types 1, 3, 4, which take their own hash arms

records.note: mask(extend(extend(0, data), last_byte)); reconstructed in PR #5396
(u32) XXH64(data || last_byte, seed 0); reconstructed in PR #5399
ROCKSDB_XXH3_64bits(data, n) then imul $0x6b9083d9 ^ last_byte; not modelled

records.observation: createState (malloc 0x30) at 0x61daa60, reset (seed 0) at 0x61daa90, update at 0x61daac0 called twice ((data, n), then (&last_byte, 1)), digest at 0x61dacf0, freeState at 0x61daa70; the digest is 32-bit and the arm returns it directly (mov %eax,%ebx at 0x616bdd3)

records.name: ROCKSDB_XXH32_reset
records.observation: zeroes the 0x30-byte state, total_len = 0, v1 = seed + PRIME32_1 + PRIME32_2, v2 = seed + PRIME32_2, v3 = seed, v4 = seed - PRIME32_1 (seed vector [P1+P2, P2, 0, -P1] at 0x451ae0)

records.name: ROCKSDB_XXH32_update
records.observation: streaming update; 16-byte stripes with the XXH32 round (imul $0x85ebca77, rol $0xd, imul $0x9e3779b1), vectorised round for a buffered stripe, memcpy tail; sets the large_len flag in the high dword of total_len

records.name: ROCKSDB_XXH32_digest
records.observation: accumulator convergence is the public rotate-sum (rol 1/7/12/18, plus total_len), then the remainder handling: 4-byte chunks (rol 17, *P4), single bytes (*P5, rol 11, *P1), then the avalanche (shr 15, *P2, shr 13, *P3, shr 16); all five primes appear as 32-bit immediates. (Correction: an earlier revision claimed merge rounds were omitted; per the upstream xxHash spec v0.2.0, XXH32 convergence is the rotate-sum only -- mergeAccumulator rounds belong to XXH64.)
